tooltips.add_file_or_folder: Accepts PDF files, image folders, or image ZIPs.
tooltips.add_file: Opens PDFs or JP2/JPEG image ZIPs.
tooltips.add_folder: Loads a book from a folder of page images.
tooltips.output_directory: Choose where processed files are saved. Outputs default to this folder.
tooltips.image_output_type: Dithered images are 1bit and may look better on e-ink.
tooltips.layout_detection: GPU accelerated layout detection also preserves image areas from binarization.
tooltips.layout_exclusion_pages: Pages to process without layout detection, e.g. 1, 3, 7-10.
tooltips.heavy_model: Heavy Sauvola AI model (ONNX) for degraded pages. benefits from layout detection.
tooltips.inverted_colors: For digitally created documents with dark background and light text. Will convert to white background, black text
tooltips.jpeg_compatibility: Maximum-compatibility encoders: JPEG for image regions, CCITT4 for binarized text (instead of JPEG2000/JBIG2). Binarized mode only.
tooltips.ocr_text_layer: Generate a new OCR text layer instead of preserving an existing one.
tooltips.ocr_fast: Full page OCR, suitable for search layer.
tooltips.ocr_thorough: Line by line OCR. Intended for EPUB creation.
tooltips.jbig2_halftone: Experimental spec standard halftone dithering; lower file sizes and lower resolution.
tooltips.high_quality_output: Use higher-quality image encoding. Not intended for e-ink readers.
tooltips.cover_format_no_cover: treat first page same as others; image format affects all non-binarized images
tooltips.cover_format_dithered: CCITT4 text with dithered image regions where enabled (global)
tooltips.target_height: Enter height for proportional output, or height x width / height width, e.g. 1200, 1200x800, or 1200 800.
tooltips.target_width: Optional fixed output width in pixels.
tooltips.width_proportional: Keep output width proportional to the page aspect ratio.
tooltips.sauvola_window_size: Local analysis window size - larger: smoother, smaller: more detail-sensitive
tooltips.sauvola_k_factor: Contrast sensitivity (0.0-1.0) - lower: more text preserved, higher: cleaner backgrounds. Benefits from layout detection.
tooltips.sauvola_r: Variance scaling - lower: less aggressive, higher: stronger adaptation to noise
tooltips.threshold_value: One cutoff for the whole page: pixels with luma below this value (0-255) become black, the rest white.
tooltips.margin_centering: Centers content area within page dimensions
tooltips.margin_crop_resize: Crops margins to content bounds and resizes to specified dimensions
tooltips.crop_free_aspect: Does not preserve aspect ratio; crops to content bounds and resizes to specified dimensions
tooltips.reflow: Re-paginates text into a clean single-column layout for the target device, reflowing words and lines from the original pages

status.processing_failed: Processing failed - check error details above

messages.settings_and_queue_reset: Settings and queue reset ({} files cleared)
messages.defaulted_output_dir: output directory defaulted to input file directory
messages.resolution_preset_missing: No resolution preset has been saved yet

queue.empty_message: No files queued - Add a file or folder to begin.

popups.docs_not_found: Documentation not found. Ensure docs/ is next to the Lege executable.
popups.ocr_detected: OCR layer detected - Leave OCR off to preserve the existing text layer.
popups.no_ocr_detected: No OCR layer found - Enable OCR to add text recognition.
popups.layout_disabled: Layout detection disabled. All encoding will be in selected 1bit format.
popups.zip_no_supported_images: {}: ZIP contains no JP2 or JPEG images
popups.folder_no_supported_images: {}: folder contains no supported images (JP2, JPEG, PNG, ...)
